10-junos-cli-reference.md

  80 [JUNOS COMMAND] Show current configuration:

 126 [JUNOS COMMAND] Commit with a message:

 138 [JUNOS COMMAND] show system commit
 142 [JUNOS COMMAND] rollback <number>
 146 [JUNOS COMMAND] show | compare

 174 [JUNOS COMMAND] show configuration interfaces
 180 [JUNOS COMMAND] Show routing table:
 182 [JUNOS COMMAND] show route
